purpose.label: What it does
purpose.ask_about: The core purpose of the application — what problem it solves, in one sentence.

business_goal.label: Business goal
business_goal.ask_about: Why this is being built — the outcome that matters to the business, not just the feature list.

target_users.label: Who uses it
target_users.ask_about: Who the actual users are, in their real-world role — not just an app account type.

roles.label: User roles
roles.ask_about: The distinct roles or permission levels inside the app and what separates them.

core_features.label: Core features
core_features.ask_about: The small number of features the app cannot ship without.

workflows.label: Key workflows
workflows.ask_about: The step-by-step journeys a user takes through the app for its main tasks.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.ask_about: Who is allowed to do what — the access-control boundary between roles.

data_requirements.label: Data to store
data_requirements.ask_about: The records or entities the app must remember, and their key fields.

business_rules.label: Business rules
business_rules.ask_about: Constraints and policies the app must enforce — pricing, limits, approval rules, and similar.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.ask_about: External services the app must connect to — payment, email, calendar, and similar.

auth.label: Sign-in
auth.ask_about: How users prove who they are — email/password, social login, invite-only, or no accounts at all.

security.label: Security
security.ask_about: Sensitive-data handling and access restrictions beyond ordinary role permissions.

performance.label: Performance
performance.ask_about: Expected load, response-time expectations, or scale the app must handle.

availability.label: Availability
availability.ask_about: Uptime expectations and what should happen if the app or a dependency goes down.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.ask_about: Whether the app must meet a specific accessibility standard or support assistive technology.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.ask_about: Whether and how the app tells users about events — email, SMS, push, or in-app.

reporting.label: Reporting
reporting.ask_about: Whether the app needs dashboards, exports, or analytics over its data.

admin_requirements.label: Admin needs
admin_requirements.ask_about: What an administrator needs to manage, moderate, or configure.

edge_cases.label: Edge cases
edge_cases.ask_about: Unusual or failure situations the app must handle gracefully.

external_services.label: External services
external_services.ask_about: Third-party APIs or platforms the app depends on, beyond its core integrations.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.ask_about: Any fixed limitation — budget, timeline, a technology that must be used, a legal requirement.

deployment.label: Deployment
deployment.ask_about: Where and how the app will be hosted.
